construct=N198W pore variant; variant_status=engineered; assembly_symmetry=icosahedral; T_number=4; T_number_basis=inferred_from_subunit_count; shell_subunit_count=240; curated_notes=Structurally characterized pore-engineered T=4 variant. PDB 9I8F / EMD-52716 is an icosahedral homo-240-mer resolved at 
3.6 Å; T=4 is inferred from the 240-subunit icosahedral architecture. N198W narrows the 5-fold pore from ~10 Å to ~5 Å, while the 6-fold pore remains fully closed with a hydrophobic barrier, without altering the overall cage architecture. No separate mutant shell diameter was explicitly reported, so shell_diameter_nm is left blank.
